canonical_resolution_rule: On any conflict, current default-branch governance, theory, evidence ledgers, and exact program artifacts override this projection.

epistemic_calibration.core_theory: PROJECT-FAR-CORE-THEORY-1.1 remains closed at its governed scopes; no contradiction is introduced by this calibration.

claim_language_guardrails: Do not describe Project FAR as newly discovered foundational mathematics of reasoning unless future evidence independently establishes that claim.

Do not infer novelty, priority, external effectiveness, product readiness, or commercial value from theorem correctness, Lean formalization, internal review, schema conformance, or W6 controlled-artifact results.
Describe FAR's current defensible contribution as an integrated contract-relative audit and representation methodology whose component mathematics includes substantial standard prior art.
Treat FORMALIZED as a mechanization-assurance label, not a theorem-difficulty or novelty score.
Treat the historical PCA-W6-EMPIRICAL-AUDIT-UTILITY identifier as provenance; summarize its result as bounded internal semantic-detection/conformance evidence.

product_thesis.required_falsification: External evidence must show that the integrated workflow catches material defects, reduces meaningful disagreement, or improves audit quality enough to justify its time, cost, and complexity.

external_program.priority_rationale: Spend external resources first on the cheapest high-information independent replication and falsification components; novelty and correctness/utility remain orthogonal.

prior_art_normalization.purpose: Prevent component prior art from being mistaken for Project FAR novelty while preserving independent EFR-N1 adjudication.
strong_antecedent_families: standard quotient, kernel, transport-of-structure, reification, tagged-sum, and finite-extension constructions

reproducibility_repair.defect: The historical theory-dependency audit depended on Git history or origin to recover its frozen base blobs and therefore failed in a git-less source archive.
reproducibility_repair.repair: Vendor the exact nine preregistered historical Git blobs, verify each against its recorded Git blob SHA, prefer historical Git when available, and fall back only to the authenticated vendored bytes.
